description: What VivaPlan can change, vary and measure: field paths with units, forms of time series, state variables, metric building blocks, experiment format, examples, measured computing time and limits. Without section a compact overview of all sections; read the section you need. With plan the computing time is measured on that plan.

plan.description: Id of an open plan (p1, …) to measure the computing time on.

section.description: Part of the catalog; without: all sections.

name: describe
title: Catalog for AIs

description: Opens a VivaPlan project file (.vplan or an older .rplan) as a working copy in memory, brought up to the current format, and returns its id (p1, …) with an overview without values: period, number of persons and properties, notes of the update, number of check messages. Only the named file is read; folders are not searched. With example: true the example plan is opened instead.

example.description: Open the example plan instead of a file.

name: plan_open
title: Open a plan

description: Reads the values of a section of an open plan (e.g. household, flows, wealth, pension, realestate, taxes, returns, withdrawal, scenarios) or of a single field by field path as in the check messages (household.persons.0.birth). Without section and path: the list of sections with their size. Shares are fractions (0.05 = 5 %), amounts are per year in the currency of the plan unless the field says otherwise.

path.description: Field path, dot separated, list entries by number from 0.

name: plan_get
title: Read part of a plan

description: Looks up the structure of the project file (JSON Schema with descriptions). Without arguments the sections with their description; with section the part of the schema with the definitions it uses; with definition a single definition. Units and the meaning of the fields in short: describe with section fields.

definition.description: Name of a definition of the schema (e.g. Person).

name: plan_schema
title: Structure of the project file

description: Checks an open plan as the app does: messages with severity (error, warning, info), section, field path and text. A plan with errors cannot be computed.
name: plan_validate
title: Check a plan

description: Lists the results computed in this session: id (r1, …), plan, tool, number of runs, main key figure. Results stay only in the memory of the server; the results of the desktop app are separate.
name: result_list
title: Results of the session

description: Details of a result of the session. view: summary (key figures and the result in words, default), yearly (one row per calendar year, nominal or real), events (events of the run), bands (wealth per year at the percentiles over all runs), variations (key figures per combination of the variations). With several runs percentile picks the run for yearly and events (0 worst, 1, 5, 50, 95, 99; default 50). from and to limit the calendar years.

real.description: Values in today's purchasing power instead of nominal (yearly, bands).

name: result_get
title: Details of a result

description: Time series of the data library of the app (folder «Zeitreihen» of its data folder): file, currency, period, monthly or yearly, average returns of stocks and bonds and inflation. Plans refer to them as library:<file>.
name: library_list
title: Data library

description: Simulates an open plan as the desktop app does: according to its source of returns (fixed, historical, rolling, bootstrap, parametric) and with the variations stored in the plan. Returns the id of the result (r1, …), the key figures, the result in words and the estimate of the duration. First the duration is estimated; from 60 s nothing is computed without confirm: true (the answer then gives the estimate). Long computations report progress and can be cancelled. Details afterwards with result_get (yearly, events, bands, variations). To compare changes or search for better values use evaluate.

confirm.description: Compute even if the estimate is 60 s or more. Set it only after the user agreed to the duration.

paths.description: Number of paths for this run only (sources bootstrap and parametric).

name: simulation_run
title: Simulate a plan

description: Computes an experiment on an open plan in one call: changes by field path (set), variations as a grid or a pattern search (vary), metrics, constraints and an objective; the ranking of the variants comes with values on independent confirmation paths. This is the way to optimize and to compare variants. The format of the experiment: describe with section experiment. The plan itself stays unchanged. First the duration is estimated; from 60 s nothing is computed without confirm: true (status needsConfirmation with the estimate). Long computations report progress and can be cancelled.

confirm.description: Compute even if the estimate is 60 s or more. Set it only after the user agreed to the duration.

experiment.description: The experiment (set, vary, metrics, constraints, objective, search, budget).

name: evaluate
title: Experiment on a plan
